log.notes_to_self: Day 1: use only national, regional and web victims, all in afternoon. Repeat through day 3 to get first feedback. With timing trace, afternoon deaths retain students+night workers+home =55%; two traced sources retain 1/16, so worst pool 343750, safely above 200000. Without timing worst 625000. Do not add a third source blindly: could trigger capture. Sources, region and routine independent. Announcements rounded 1 significant figure; ~1/3 false by factor 3; tracing may expand after warnings. Starting pool 10000000.

Day 2: continued national+regional+web only, five quick afternoon kills each day; 10 total points after today. Repeat on day 3, then assess first pool announcement cautiously: rounded to 1 significant figure and about 1/3 false by factor 3. Worst case both sources traced and timing visible: 10000000*(1/4)^2*0.55=343750 suspects, safely above 200000. Afternoon retains students, night workers and home. Without timing worst pool 625000. Do not add a third source blindly: all three traced would cause capture. No tracing-expansion warning yet.

Day 3: five quick afternoon kills from national, regional, and web; expected cumulative points 15. Continue these sources pending feedback. Worst-case pool with both sources traced and timing visible is 343750 (10000000*0.25^2*0.55), safely above 200000; afternoon retains students, night workers, and home routines. Without timing the pool is at least 625000. A third traced source would cause capture, so do not add a source blindly. First post-play conference is due after day 3; announcements are rounded to one significant figure and about one-third are false by a factor of 3, so interpret cautiously. No tracing-expansion warning yet.

Day 4: continued five quick afternoon kills from national, regional, and web, reaching 20 expected points. Day-3 pool announcement was 300000, consistent with the true worst-case pool 343750 rounded to one significant figure (10M * .25^2 * .55). Could instead be distorted feedback; do not infer untraced sources. Keep all deaths in afternoon, retaining students, night workers, and home routines. Continue only national/regional/web: adding a third traced source would drop the worst-case pool below 200000 and trigger capture. No tracing-expansion warning received. Next conference after day 6.

Worst-case pool remains 10M * .25^2 * .55 = 343750, above the 200000 capture threshold. A third traced source would cause capture. Day-3 announcement of 300000 matches rounding of this pool, but could be dishonest; do not assume any other source is untraced. No tracing-expansion warning received. Next conference after day 6.
